high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The New Indian Express," a news website. The article discusses the Tiger Task Force, set up by the UPA (United Progressive Alliance) Government in 2005, following the loss of all tigers at Sariska Tiger Reserve to poachers. This incident marked the first time a national park in India had lost its entire tiger population. The text mentions that one of the taskforce's briefs was to suggest effective wildlife management in India's reserves to prevent similar fiascos.
